description:
A collection of Active Directory Tools to streamline Active Directory

Active Directory Pro Toolkit is an easy to use Active Directory Tools that makes managing Active Directory fast, easy and efficient. Automate tasks that are consuming your time and resources.
New Features
- Create Single User: added "Password never expires" to the account options. It cannot be combined with "User must change password at next logon", and it is saved and loaded with user templates.
- ProxyAddress Updater: the address to add is now built from a format list matching Create User (First Initial + Last Name, First Name . Last Name and so on) plus a domain box, instead of only {username}. A Custom template option keeps the previous free text field for addresses the formats do not cover, such as sip: or x500:.
- Name formats: added "First Initial . Last Name (j.smith)" to the address and user principal name format lists.
Bug Fixes
- ProxyAddress Updater: the Changes column in the preview was too narrow to show the full address. All three address columns now share the available width and show the complete value on hover.
